title: Abstract Definitive Depth Shift
description: Schema fragment which enables the embedding of a definitive depth shift within OSDU schemas.

DefinitiveDepthShiftSourceID.title: Definitive Depth Shift Source ID
DefinitiveDepthShiftSourceID.description: Identifies the well log that was used to create this depth shift. Usually this identifies a log record with a wireline gamma ray curve.

DefinitiveDepthShiftID.title: Definitive Depth Shift ID
DefinitiveDepthShiftID.description: Identifies the definitive depth shift record applied to the object.

DepthShiftedAttributes.title: Depth Shifted Attributes
DepthShiftedAttributes.description: Identifies the attributes impacted by the depth shift and their persisted depth-shifted values.

items.title: Depth Shifted Attribute
items.description: Identifies an attribute impacted by the depth shift and its persisted depth-shifted values.

DepthShiftAttributeName.title: Depth Shift Attribute Name
DepthShiftAttributeName.description: Identifies the attribute name in this data record that is impacted by the depth shift.

DepthShiftedAmount.title: Depth Shifted Amount
DepthShiftedAmount.description: Defines the amount of depth shifted from the original, as-received, depths for this data attribute. Positive values represent depth-shifting downhole in depth, while negative values represent depth shifting uphole.

DepthShiftedVerticalMeasurementValue.title: Depth Shifted Vertical Measurement Value
DepthShiftedVerticalMeasurementValue.description: Persisted depth-shifted vertical measurement value, for the identified attribute.

DepthShiftUnitOfMeasureID.title: Depth Shift Unit of Measure ID
DepthShiftUnitOfMeasureID.description: Defines the unit of measure for DepthShiftedAmount and DepthShiftedVerticalMeasurementValue.
